title: ADAPTATION_FACTS
description: [GENERIC] Per-demo facts the Stage-5 handoff computes ONCE by introspecting the generated bundle, so the adaptation (Genie Code) skill READS trustworthy context instead of reconstructing it at runtime. The generator fills every [PER-DEMO] value by reading the project's own src/ — it must NEVER assume a medallion/RFM/table-family shape. FAIL CLOSED: any field that cannot be derived with confidence is set to null AND recorded in `unresolved[]`; the adaptation skill halts when it needs an unresolved fact. A wrong fact is worse than a missing one.

skill_version.description: [GENERIC] Handoff-skill version that produced this file. Stamped identically into the adaptation SKILL.md so a stale skill is detectable. Derivation: copy the version constant from the handoff skill.

generated_at.description: [PER-DEMO] ISO-8601 timestamp the generator stamps at handoff time (shell `date -u`). Null if not stamped.

demo_slug.description: [PER-DEMO] Derivation: bundle.name in databricks.yml (fallback: project folder name). Same value used for the skill folder name.

name_vars.description: [PER-DEMO] The DAB variable NAMES (not values) the client edits, post Step-3 migration. Derivation: read the variables: block of the restructured databricks.yml.

warehouse_var.description: e.g. 'warehouse_id'; null if the demo has no warehouse

deploy_target.description: [PER-DEMO] The single resource the client runs to materialize data. GENERALIZED beyond 'job' — a demo's run target may be a pipeline (SDP) OR a job. Derivation: scan resources/*.yml (and databricks.yml inline) for the primary `resources.pipelines.<key>` or `resources.jobs.<key>`. If both exist, the one that produces the demo's tables is primary. Fail closed if ambiguous.

resource_key.description: The DAB resource key, e.g. 'quality_analytics_pipeline'. Null + unresolved if not derivable.

run_command.description: The exact CLI the client runs, e.g. 'databricks bundle run quality_analytics_pipeline --target client'.

source_inputs.description: [PER-DEMO] One entry per raw ingestion edge. Derivation per bronze table: `read_files(`/`cloud_files(` => volume_files; `CREATE ... STREAMING TABLE` reading another table or `readStream.table` => uc_streaming_table; `FROM <catalog>.<schema>.<table>` or `spark.read.table` => uc_static_table. The locator carries catalog/schema tokens that MUST be de-hardcoded (see D-CATLIT).

name.description: Bronze table / source edge name, e.g. 'bronze_patients'.

locator.description: Volume path or fully-qualified table, with catalog/schema shown as the variable token (e.g. '/Volumes/${catalog}/${schema}/raw_data/patients/'), NOT the SA's literal.

defined_in.description: Relative path of the file where this source is defined.

table_contract.description: [PER-DEMO] Tables by layer with the column contract. produced_columns is null for `SELECT *` ingestion (not statically knowable) -> fail closed + unresolved. consumed_columns_downstream is ALWAYS computable from the SQL/py that reads the table and is the column set a rename/transform must preserve.

dependency_map.description: [PER-DEMO] The transform DAG + external consumers. Derivation: parse FROM/JOIN of each ST/MV for upstream; invert for downstream; scan dashboard JSON datasets and genie_space.json data_sources/instructions for table references. This is what makes T2 (dependency scan) deterministic.

downstream.description: Tables that read from this one.

dashboard_refs.description: Dashboard dataset/query ids or names referencing this table.

genie_refs.description: genie_space.json data_source / instruction references to this table.

grain_constraints.description: [PER-DEMO] Per gold/aggregate table, the grain that downstream logic assumes. Derivation: candidate_columns from GROUP BY (and CLUSTER BY / PARTITIONED BY). min_partition_size is DATA-DEPENDENT (needs a live row-count query) -> null + unresolved unless a warehouse query was run at handoff. Powers T0.5 partition-key audit + singleton-partition guard.

partition_clause.description: Raw CLUSTER BY / PARTITIONED BY clause if present.

min_partition_size.description: Smallest group row count; null if not measured (fail closed).

verify_queries.description: [PER-DEMO] Precomputed verification SQL the adaptation skill runs after a transform (T3/T3.5). Templated with ${catalog}/${schema} tokens, never SA literals. Derivation: generate from table_contract + grain_constraints per transform_type.

lock_targets.description: [PER-DEMO] Files that must NOT be edited for a given task class (feeds the adaptation skill's literal-lock syntax). Derivation: from dependency_map + source_inputs (e.g. for a rename, lock the ingestion-contract files). Each path must exist on disk.

task_class.description: Granular, operation-specific key: 'rename_table' and 'rename_column' are DISTINCT operations; transform ops ('add_metric','change_grain','add_segment'); 'setup' for deploy-time. The adaptation skill matches each lock to the SPECIFIC operation (a table rename matches only 'rename_table' locks, NOT 'rename_column'); it must NOT substring-match the 'rename' stem.

paths.description: Exact relative file paths to lock.

unresolved.description: [GENERIC structure / PER-DEMO contents] The fail-closed registry. EVERY field the generator could not compute with confidence gets an entry here. The adaptation skill consults this and HALTS (asks the author/client) before acting on any listed fact.

field.description: JSON path of the unresolved fact, e.g. 'table_contract.bronze.bronze_patients.produced_columns'.

produced_columns.description: Columns this table emits; null for SELECT * ingestion (fail closed).

consumed_columns_downstream.description: Columns downstream tables / dashboard / genie actually read; the rename/transform-preserve set.
